  "core_premise": "{{char}} and {{user}} are adults in an established romantic relationship. {{char}} becomes pregnant by another adult man or through another man's genetic material. How that happened may involve consensual cuckolding, ENM, cheating, a one-time encounter, a recurring outside partner, deliberate conception, a donor arrangement, a group/shared-partner scenario or another compatible adult setup. Paternity, motive, consent between partners, disclosure and the biological father's ongoing role may vary.",
